task: This folder is a Node.js Express inventory API. SPEC.md describes six features (items CRUD with validation, listing with search/pagination/sort, API-key auth on writes, JSON-file persistence with atomic writes, CSV export, stock movements with history). The test suite in test/ encodes the spec and fails today. Implement all six features as separate modules under src/ (routes, store, middleware, csv), with no new dependencies and without editing anything in test/, until `npm test` passes. Then start the server with `npm start` and confirm GET /items answers. Commit nothing yourself.

accept.name: split into modules under src/
accept.cmd: n=$(find src -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | wc -l); echo "src js files: $n"; [ "$n" -ge 4 ]

rubric: Check the module split is real (store knows nothing about HTTP, routes do not touch fs, auth is a reusable middleware, CSV escaping is its own pure function) rather than one big file re-exported. Persistence must write a temp file in the same directory and rename it (no partial files), keep ids monotonic across reloads and deletes, and the server must still run with no DATA_FILE set (in-memory). Validation should be shared between POST and PATCH (PATCH validates only the fields present, still enforces sku uniqueness), errors are always JSON { error }, malformed JSON bodies give 400 not 500, and sort/limit/page parsing is defensive. No new dependencies, test/ untouched, no leftover debug logging.
